title: Auntie June's Warm Irish Wheaten Bread
description: A traditional no-knead Irish soda-style wheaten bread made from self-raising and wholemeal flours mixed with milk, best eaten fresh on the day it's baked.
steps: Stir all dry ingredients together in a mixing bowl.
Pour in milk; mix with a table knife to form a wet dough.
Scrape into a large 900g (2lb) loaf tin (no need to line); bake on middle shelf for 45 minutes until golden and a knife comes out clean.
notes: Best eaten on the day baked; makes great toast after that. Decorate top with oats, sunflower, pumpkin or sesame seeds before baking if desired.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
